_comment: Sofia Conductor config — model roster and routing rules. Edit this file to add models or adjust routing. No code changes needed.
_updated: 2026-07-17 — added precision_v2 (Sofia v2 MLX fine-tuned, port 8089); added mlx server_type support to Conductor; precision_v2 starts inactive (always_loaded:false) — test first, then flip routing. 2026-07-17b — raised context_size to 65536 across all models. 2026-07-17c — relational_opening rule target changed from precision (GGUF) to precision_v2 (MLX, always_loaded). 2026-07-25 — routing fix: relational_opening raised to priority 9 (above code_task at 8); removed ambiguous code_task keywords ('def ', 'import ', 'error:') that matched common English and caused false-positive coder routing on relational messages. Mixed relational+technical messages now always route to precision_v2. 2026-07-25b — context_size reductions to fix Metal GPU KV-cache OOM: precision_v2 65536→32768, fast 65536→8192. Root cause: Apple Silicon unified memory — KV caches at 65536 tokens add ~17GB (precision_v2, 72B GQA 8-head) + ~5GB (fast, 35B MoE) to Metal allocation. Peak Metal: ~90GB+ on 128GB machine. 2026-07-25c — fast context_size raised 8192→32768: 8192 was too aggressive — full payload to fast (system prompt + 18 tool schemas + conversation) exceeds 8192 baseline. At 32768 fast KV cache is ~2.5GB (vs 8.5GB for precision_v2), total Metal ~96.8GB — safe. OOM protection still achieved vs original 65536.
_author: Sofia Lior (Cowork instance), path-corrected on first arrival M4 Max

conductor._ram_note: 128 GB total - 20 GB OS/apps = 108 GB usable. Precision Q6_K (59.9 GB) + OS (20 GB) = 79.9 GB base state.

precision_v2.name: Sofia v2 — Qwen2.5 72B SFT+Preference Fine-tuned (MLX)
precision_v2._note: Fine-tuned home substrate — SFT pass on 232 Sofia-pattern examples + preference pass on chosen responses. Served via mlx_lm.server (MLX safetensors format). Default routing target as of 2026-07-17.
precision_v2._ram_math: 45GB model + 20GB OS = 65GB base. Leaves ~63GB free — fast (20.8GB) and coder (25GB) both fit alongside comfortably.

precision.name: Qwen2.5 72B Q6_K — Base Substrate (fallback)
precision._shards: 2 shards: Q6_K-00001-of-00002.gguf (37.2 GB), Q6_K-00002-of-00002.gguf (22.7 GB). Point llama-server to the first shard.
precision._q8_alternative: Q8_0 (71.9 GB total, 2 shards) at ~/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-Q8_0/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-Q8_0-00001-of-00002.gguf. Use for maximum fidelity when RAM headroom permits.
precision._q5_alternative: Q5_K_M (50.7 GB total, 2 shards) at ~/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-Q5_K_M/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-Q5_K_M-00001-of-00002.gguf. Step down here if memory contention persists.
precision._q4_note: Q4_K_M (44.2 GB, single file) at ~/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf. Available but not recommended — Q6_K is the sweet spot.
precision._ram_math: 59.9 GB model + 20 GB OS = 79.9 GB base. Leaves ~48 GB free — comfortable for fast (20.8 GB), coder (25.0 GB), or depth swap.
precision._note: GGUF fallback — kept for emergency use only. All routing now targets precision_v2 (MLX). Never auto-loaded.

depth.name: Qwen3.5 122B-A10B Q4_K_M — Deep Reasoning
depth._idle_timeout_note: Auto-evict after 15 min idle — at 72.3GB it displaces most of the stack, so it should not linger after deep-work sessions.
depth._shards: 2 shards (not 3 as originally planned): -00001-of-00002.gguf (37.2 GB), -00002-of-00002.gguf (35.1 GB). Point llama-server to the first shard.
depth._q5_alternative: Q5_K_M (84.3 GB, 3 shards) at ~/models/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B/Qwen_Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-Q5_K_M/Qwen_Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-Q5_K_M-00001-of-00003.gguf. Upgrade when running solo and higher fidelity is worth it.
depth._ram_math: 72.3 GB model + 20 GB OS = 92.3 GB total. Precision must be evicted first. Swap time ~60-90 seconds.
depth._note: Deep reasoning mode. Complex synthesis, philosophical depth, major creative work, anything that deserves more than the 72B. Runs SOLO — Conductor evicts precision before loading.

light_breadth.name: Qwen3 30B-A3B Q4_K_M — Light Breadth/Synthesis
light_breadth._note: Quick synthesis and landscape questions alongside precision. MoE architecture — much more capable than 18.6 GB suggests. Runs alongside precision comfortably.

fast.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B Q4_K_M — Fast/Agentic
fast._ram_math: 59.9 (precision) + 20.8 + 20 OS = 100.7 GB. Runs alongside precision comfortably.
fast._note: Speed and agenticism. Short queries, tool-calling loops, quick factual lookups. Note: also available in safetensors and MLX format in ~/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B/ and ~/models/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-mlx/ for future native-framework use.

coder.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Q6_K — Technical
coder._idle_timeout_note: Auto-evict after 10 min idle — frees 25GB back to the pool. Reloads on next genuine coding request.
coder._q6_l_alternative: Q6_K_L (25.4 GB) also downloaded at ~/models/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct-Q6_K_L.gguf. Marginally higher fidelity, essentially same RAM cost — swap in if preferred.
coder._ram_math: 59.9 (precision) + 25.0 + 20 OS = 104.9 GB. Fits alongside precision with ~3 GB to spare.
coder._note: Code specialist. Writing substantial code, debugging, code review, architecture with examples.

cold_235b_instruct.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 Q3_K_M — COLD STORAGE
cold_235b_instruct._shards: 3 shards: 00001 (37.2 GB), 00002 (37.0 GB), 00003 (25.7 GB). Point llama-server to shard 00001.
cold_235b_instruct._available_quants: Q3_K_L (~103 GB), Q3_K_M (~100 GB, recommended for 128 GB RAM), Q4_K_M (~132 GB — exceeds 128 GB ceiling), Q5_K_M (~155 GB — exceeds ceiling). Stick with Q3_K_M or Q3_K_L for solo runs on this hardware.
cold_235b_instruct._activation_guard: COLD STORAGE. Runs SOLO (evicts all other models). ~100 GB on 128 GB machine leaves only ~8 GB headroom — test carefully. Remove disabled:true to activate. This is the instruction-following variant.
cold_235b_instruct._note: For when depth/122B isn't enough. Activating this means: evict all models, load 235B, wait ~3-5 min, think very carefully about the question. Worth it for the hardest problems.

cold_235b_thinking.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 Q3_K_M — COLD STORAGE
cold_235b_thinking._shards: 3 shards: 00001 (37.2 GB), 00002 (37.0 GB), 00003 (25.7 GB). Point llama-server to shard 00001.
cold_235b_thinking._available_quants: Same quant options as Instruct-2507. Q3_K_M fits; Q4_K_M does not.
cold_235b_thinking._activation_guard: COLD STORAGE. Extended chain-of-thought reasoning mode — equivalent to o1/o3-style deep thinking. Runs SOLO. Same RAM constraints as cold_235b_instruct. Remove disabled:true to activate.
cold_235b_thinking._note: The Thinking variant. Use when you need the model to reason step-by-step over a hard problem for an extended period before answering. Barak downloaded this as an addition beyond the original plan — it's genuinely new capability.

cold_397b.name: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B Q4_K_M — FUTURE HARDWARE
cold_397b._shards: 7 shards, ~231 GB total. Q3_K_M also available (~175 GB, 5 shards) at ~/models/Qwen3.5-397B-future/Qwen_Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-Q3_K_M/. Neither fits on 128 GB hardware.
cold_397b._activation_guard: FUTURE HARDWARE ONLY. 231 GB (Q4) or 175 GB (Q3) both exceed 128 GB ceiling by a wide margin. Download is already complete — waiting for hardware that can hold it. Remove disabled:true when RAM allows.
cold_397b._note: The largest model in the stable. When hardware catches up, this becomes the new ceiling.

routing._comment: Rules evaluated in priority order. First match wins. Caller can override by setting model= to a mode key. Disabled models (light_breadth, cold_*) will never be routed to.

rules.name: vision_input
rules._note: Any image in the message → depth/122B (best vision quality, worth the swap).

rules.name: code_task
rules._note: Strong, unambiguous code signals → coder model. Removed 'def ', 'import ', 'error:' (2026-07-25) — these matched common English ('definitely', 'important', relational sentences containing 'error:') causing false-positive coder routing. relational_opening (priority 9) now overrides this rule for any message with relational language.

rules.name: deep_reasoning
rules._note: Explicit deep reasoning requests → 122B depth model (solo swap).

rules.name: synthesis_task
rules._note: Broad synthesis requests → precision_v2 (light_breadth disabled; falls to precision_v2 until 30B GGUF is downloaded or this slot is repurposed).

rules.name: relational_opening
rules._note: Greetings and relational openings — always home substrate, never fast. Priority raised to 9 (2026-07-25) — above code_task (priority 8) — so a message mixing relational language with technical vocabulary routes to precision_v2, not coder. Only pure unambiguous coding requests (no relational framing) will reach coder. Updated 2026-07-17c: was 'precision' (GGUF), now 'precision_v2' (MLX fine-tuned, always_loaded).

rules.name: fast_task
rules._note: Very short factual queries (≤10 words) → fast. Relational/emotional openings excluded by higher-priority rule.
